description: This file defines a React functional component 'AnnotationModal' used for creating and editing annotations within a user interface. It includes state management, form handling, JSON validation, and interactions with backend resources for annotations. The component renders a modal dialog with input fields, date pickers, and a JSON editor, supporting both add and edit modes.

methods.name: toEditorAnnotations
methods.description: Converts Ace editor annotations to EditorAnnotation format used internally.

methods.name: resetAnnotation
methods.description: Resets the current annotation state to default empty values.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the modal and resets or restores annotation data based on mode.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving the annotation, either by creating or updating via API.

methods.name: onAnnotationTextChange
methods.description: Updates annotation state when text inputs change.

methods.name: onJsonChange
methods.description: Updates annotation state when JSON metadata changes.

methods.name: onDateChange
methods.description: Updates annotation start and end date/time based on date picker input.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates required fields to enable or disable the save button.
